mapper.sql: w.id, w.title, w.content, w.category, w.priority, w.due_date, w.status, w.counselor_id, w.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , u.real_name AS counselor_name FROM work_record w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON w.counselor_id = u.id WHERE w.record_type = 'TASK' AND w.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_record (record_type, title, content, category, priority, due_date, status, counselor_id) VALUES ('TASK', #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{priority}, #{dueDate}, #{status}, #{counselorId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM work_record WHERE record_type = 'TASK' AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM work_record WHERE record_type = 'TASK' AND status = #{status}
